# Executive summary
Automated summary placeholder. Biological interpretation must be generated only after a validated real-data run.

# Dataset and provenance
Record BioProject, reference assembly, sample selection, population labels and exclusions.

# Sequencing and alignment QC
MultiQC, mapping rate, depth and sample exclusions.

# Variant QC
Raw SNP count, filtering waterfall, missingness, MAF and retained SNP count.

# Genetic diversity
Observed/expected heterozygosity and allele-frequency summaries.

# Inbreeding
FIS, pairwise kinship and ROH/FROH summaries.

# Population structure
LD-pruned PCA with metadata-defined groups.

# Limitations
Document sequencing-depth heterogeneity, population imbalance, hard-call assumptions and sensitivity analyses.
